---
params:
  x:          NULL
  tab_title:  ""
  meta:       !r NULL
  collective: !r NULL
title: "\\fontsize{14}{16}\\selectfont Zuwachs auf Betriebsebene -- Ertragstafelschätzung"
date: ""
classoption:
  - a4paper
geometry:
  - portrait
  - "left=1.2cm,right=1.2cm,top=1cm,bottom=1.2cm"
fontsize: 11pt
header-includes:
  # Suppress page numbers. The output is a single page by design (one
  # overview table + yield-table list + footnote). \maketitle applies
  # \thispagestyle{plain} which prints a centred "1" at the bottom --
  # override both `plain` and the global pagestyle to render an empty
  # footer instead.
  - \usepackage{fancyhdr}
  - \pagestyle{empty}
  - \fancypagestyle{plain}{\fancyhf{}\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
latex_escape <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(x)
  x <- as.character(x)
  gsub("([&%$#_])", "\\\\\\1", x)
}
```

```{r header-block, results = "asis"}
m  <- params$meta
co <- params$collective

if (!is.null(params$tab_title) && nzchar(params$tab_title)) {
  cat("\\vspace{-1.2em}\\begin{center}\n",
      "{\\large\\textbf{", latex_escape(params$tab_title), "}}\n",
      "\\end{center}\\vspace{-0.6em}\n", sep = "")
}
if (!is.null(co$label)) {
  cat("\\begin{center}\\small ", latex_escape(co$label),
      "\\end{center}\\vspace{-0.6em}\n", sep = "")
}
if (!is.null(m)) {
  fmt_ha <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",",
                               scientific = FALSE)
  parts <- character(0)
  if (!is.null(m$year))    parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Inventurjahr:} ",
                                                    as.integer(m$year)))
  if (!is.null(m$area_ha)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Gesamtfl\\\"ache:} ",
                                                    fmt_ha(m$area_ha), " ha"))
  if (!is.null(m$n_plots)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Inventurpunkte:} ",
                                                    as.integer(m$n_plots)))
  if (length(parts) > 0)
    cat("\\begin{center}\\small ", paste(parts, collapse = "\\qquad "),
        "\\end{center}\\vspace{-0.3em}\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r overview-table}
oo <- options(fe_spec_lang = "ger")

fmt_num <- function(v, dig = 1) ifelse(
  is.na(v), "",
  formatC(round(v, dig), format = "f", digits = dig,
          big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
)

ovr    <- params$x$overview
no_ms  <- if (is.null(ovr$is_no_main_stand_row)) rep(FALSE, nrow(ovr)) else ovr$is_no_main_stand_row
labels <- format(ovr$species_group)
labels[no_ms]            <- "Inventurpunkte ohne lebenden Hauptbestand"
labels[ovr$is_total_row] <- "Total"

t1 <- tibble::tibble(
  Baumart                   = labels,
  `Anteilige Fläche (ha)`   = fmt_num(ovr$area_ha),
  `Mittlere Ertragsklasse`  = fmt_num(ovr$site_index),
  `zv (m³/ha/J)`            = fmt_num(ovr$zv_m3_ha_yr, 2),
  `zv (m³/J)`               = fmt_num(ovr$zv_m3_yr)
)

kbl <- knitr::kable(t1, booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE,
                    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(which(ovr$is_total_row), bold = TRUE) |>
  # Fix column 1 width so the long "no living main stand" label wraps instead
  # of widening the table off the page edge.
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "4.6cm")

# Set the "no living main stand" row slightly apart from the species rows.
if (any(no_ms)) {
  kbl <- kbl |>
    kableExtra::row_spec(which(no_ms) - 1L,
                         extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.6em]")
}

kbl |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"),
                            full_width = FALSE)
options(oo)
```

```{r ytables-used, results = "asis"}
oo <- options(fe_spec_lang = "ger")
yt <- params$x$ytables_used

# One row per (species group, yield table): tables are listed one per line,
# even when a species group uses several different tables. The Baumart label
# is shown only on the first line of each group.
t2 <- yt |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$species_group) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    .lab = ifelse(dplyr::row_number() == 1L,
                  format(.data$species_group), "")
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::transmute(`Baumart/Artgruppe` = .data$.lab,
                   Ertragstafel = .data$name_orig)

cat("\\vspace{1em}\n\\noindent\\textbf{Verwendete Ertragstafeln}\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")
print(
  knitr::kable(t2, booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, linesep = "", align = c("l", "l")) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"),
                              full_width = FALSE)
)
options(oo)
```

```{r footnote, results = "asis"}
ovr_fn    <- params$x$overview
has_no_ms <- !is.null(ovr_fn$is_no_main_stand_row) &&
             any(ovr_fn$is_no_main_stand_row)

cat("\\begin{flushleft}\\vspace{0.6em}\\small\\itshape\n")
cat("Alle Volumenangaben verstehen sich als Erntefestmeter ohne Rinde ",
    "(Efm o.R.).\n", sep = "")
cat("\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")
cat("Diese Tabelle bezieht sich nur auf den Hauptbestand (ein Teilkollektiv); ",
    "die je Baumart ausgewiesenen Hektarwerte beziehen sich auf einen Hektar ",
    "des jeweiligen (virtuellen) Reinbestandes der Baumart. Die Ertragsklasse ",
    "ist tafelspezifisch -- ein Gesamtmittel \\\"uber Baumarten wird daher ",
    "nicht ausgewiesen.\n", sep = "")
if (has_no_ms) {
  cat("\\par\\vspace{0.3em}\n")
  cat("Der Hektarwert der Zeile \"Total\" bezieht sich dagegen auf die gesamte ",
      "Betriebsfl\\\"ache (einschlie\\ss{}lich der Inventurpunkte ohne lebenden ",
      "Hauptbestand); die Zuwachssumme bleibt davon unber\\\"uhrt.\n", sep = "")
}
cat("\\end{flushleft}\n")
```
